(let [unpaid (remove :paid invoices)
        owed (reduce + 0 (map :amount unpaid))
        open (count unpaid)
        balance (max (- owed credit) 0)]

      (println "open invoices" open))
    [balance open])

(let [pending-payments (remove :paid payments)

    [remainder pending])
